description: Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited is the national stock exchange of Pakistan and, in its own words, the frontline regulator of the country's capital market. It was formed on 11 January 2016 when the Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad exchanges integrated their operations under the Stock Exchanges (Corporatization, Demutualization and Integration) Act, 2012. It lists 535 companies plus 5 on the GEM Board, across 37 sectors, with a market capitalisation of Rs 19.83 trillion as of 31 August 2026, and its shareholding is 40% held by a consortium of Chinese investors — Shanghai Stock Exchange, Shenzhen Stock Exchange and China Financial Futures Exchange — and 60% by the general public.
